title: Joetastic Help Signal
description: Visual/audio cue for the D&D 5e Help action. Three flavors — Help-Attack (advantage on attacks against target), Help-Save (disadvantage on target's next save), and Help-Ability (marker-only). Plays per-player configurable sound + Sequencer animation on apply, on trigger, and on expiration. Requires Sequencer and JB2A.
